compatibility.linuxQt: v1 SDK writer + fMP4 H264/AAC + WebM VP9/Opus
compatibility.windowsQt: v1 SDK writer + scalar VP9/Opus + segmented H264/AAC and VP9/Opus

initialCorrections: Catalog detection must inspect the bounded JSON envelope, not feed segmentCatalog into the inline parser.
Standalone producer import path corrected; private existing Xvfb tools selected without modifying the desktop.
The one-tick TS index and ffprobe AAC sub-PES rounding are separate; real maximum is 132 x 100 ns.

Negative audio preroll exposed an actual adapter bug: 100 ns audio media time caused FFmpeg to report skip_samples=800000 instead of 3840 at 80 ms/48 kHz. Audio now uses its sampling rate and exact 1024-sample durations; native decoded hashes and all three player scenarios pass.
limitations: Two required separate AVC/AAC TS VOD tracks; no muxed HLS/DASH, arbitrary codecs, VFR/interlace/POC1, rollover, configuration change or live.
Strict framing is not full entropy validation; actual decoder remains authoritative.
No multi-hour/sync/physical output/source-site acceptance or maximum-index stress; bounds are admission limits.
Synchronous worker preparation copies growing immutable metadata/index; very large completed-catalog startup requires further cost assessment.
These are source/client SDK additions; Windows installed applications and their INIs were not replaced.
